name: Microlaunch

sources.title: Premium page — Launch Pro $39 (code LAUNCH20), Launch Plus $79 (code LAUNCH-PLUS-20), product-review add-on $129; 'Skip the Queue — Launch Anytime'
Homepage — 30-day launch program, leaderboard, deals, community

conditions: A regular (free) launch exists — Premium is framed as 'Skip the Queue', implying a free queue — but the free tier's details are not published on the premium page
Launch Pro ($39 with LAUNCH20) buys anytime-launch, 2 boosts, Product-of-Day eligibility, 4+ SEO pages, marketplace/deals spot, verified badge, DR64+ dofollow backlinks
Launch Plus ($79 with LAUNCH-PLUS-20) adds 4 more SEO pages, 3 automated boosts, X mention (10.2k) and Reddit post (1.3k)
requirements: A startup/product to launch — the program runs a 30-day exposure campaign
Re-launches allowed 'for major feature releases only'
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline, description, logo/screenshots
Deal terms if you want a marketplace/deals placement
Choose tier: free queue (details scarce) / Launch Pro $39 / Launch Plus $79 / +$129 review-and-action-plan add-on
Plan for 30 days of engagement — feedback, roasts and testimonial collection are part of the program
workflow: Submit the product ('Launch Now') — free queue or paid tier
Paid: check out with the pre-published discount codes (LAUNCH20 / LAUNCH-PLUS-20)
Launch runs a 30-day campaign: leaderboard, boosts, deals marketplace, reviews/roasts
Product lives at a product page plus 4+ SEO-optimized pages under /alt/ and similar
watchFor: Discount codes are printed on the page — never pay the struck-through price ($49/$99)
Re-launch limited to major feature releases
The 'lifetime launch pack' language implies one-time pricing, but confirm at checkout
Free-tier mechanics (queue length, backlink policy) are not described on public pages
Expert review add-on ($129) is limited to 2 startup slots/week and is a separate upsell
countsAsLive: Product appears on microlaunch.net/browse and the leaderboard with a public product page during its 30-day campaign
unknowns: Free launch queue length and what the free tier includes
Whether paid tiers are one-time or recurring
How 'boosts' and 'Product of the Day' are awarded
